svg.text: Virasat Setu: Complete Platform UI and UX Design Board
Group 14 DTI Project: Full Architectural Visual Blueprint for Citizen, Administrator, and Institutional Desks
1. Citizen Portal Home Landing Screen
Public landing page with four stage workflow and wealth counter
2. Google Identity OAuth Authentication
Authentication dialog with Continue with Google and role switcher
3. Authenticated Citizen Family Dashboard
Family metrics, submitted records table and active claims summary
4. Deceased Person Civil Registration Form
Four section civil death registration with PAN and municipal refs
5. Discovered Assets and Matching Console
Automated matching results with one hundred point confidence scores
6. Viru: Virasat AI Legal Copilot Dialog
Conversational legal intelligence with succession statutory guidance
7. Citizen AI Claim Health Predictor Modal
Embedded claim dialog with readiness score ring and document checklist
8. Claim Progress Tracking Console
Five stage claim lifecycle progress stepper and officer remarks
9. Central Administrative Oversight Console
Platform vital statistics, review queue, verify action and user panel
10. Central Financial Database Browser
Categorized directory searching across ninety four institutional records
11. Institutional Claim Processing Desk
Banking and insurance claims queue with tripartite decision controls
12. Administrative AI Fraud and Anomaly Center
Conflict detection for duplicate claims and high value dormancy
13. System Notifications Center Modal
Real time system alerts, discovery updates and simulated email headers
14. Official Sovereign Brand Emblem Master
Sovereign arch, Kalpavriksha seedling and national wealth nodes
15. Coursework Reference Visual
Official coursework group and project identification visual
